verdict.rationale: Only a single old community comment (from the 2020 beta) claims the database 'cost scale to 0, so it is perfect for small projects,' and no current vendor docs in the pack describe a scale-to-zero or free-tier mechanism; another community comment notes the hobby/free tier was later removed, casting doubt on whether idle prototypes truly cost nothing today. missing for 10: current first-party documentation describing scale-to-zero billing/behavior, confirmation that idle databases remain durable while scaled down, and evidence of an active free/hobby tier for side projects.
